Title: New Azure Monitor Application Insights agent is now available

Body.Content:
It’s now possible to monitor your ASP.NET applications hosted on Azure Virtual Machines running IIS without touching a line of code by installing the new Application Insights agent on your VM. This new onboarding method is especially useful if you don’t have access to the code. Use the Azure portal in your VM extensions blade or read the step-by-step onboarding guide to learn more.

Onboarding guide
